findings.summary: Sam Altman is Managing Director of Hydrazine Capital Management LLC since September 2020
findings.detail: Form ADV for Hydrazine Capital Management, LLC (CRD 332160, filed 3/25/2026) Schedule A shows: ALTMAN, SAM — Individual — MANAGING DIRECTOR OF HYDRAZINE CAPITAL MANAGEMENT, LLC — Title/Status Acquired 09/2020 — Ownership Code E (75% or more) — Control Person: Yes.

findings.summary: Hydrazine Corporation is a controlling member of Hydrazine Capital Management LLC with Sam Altman as 75%+ owner
findings.detail: Form ADV Schedule A shows Hydrazine Corporation (DE entity, company #6697154, formed 2022-03-25) became a member of Hydrazine Capital Management LLC in 03/2022. Schedule B shows Sam Altman as owner of Hydrazine Corporation with ownership code E (75%+), acquired 03/2022. This creates a two-layer ownership: Sam Altman owns Hydrazine Corporation which is a member of the management entity.

findings.summary: Total Hydrazine Capital platform AUM exceeds $1.9B including Apollo Projects
findings.detail: Aggregated from Form ADV (CRD 332160, filed 3/25/2026): Fund I $30.2M + Fund II LP $424.6M + Fund II SPV $514.2M + Fund II AIV $7.2M + Fund III $105.7M + Fund IV $310.8M = $1.393B Hydrazine funds; plus Apollo Projects LP $553.2M under same management entity = $1.946B total platform.

findings.summary: Carmen Beckwith serves as CFO across all three IAPD-registered Hydrazine Capital entities
findings.detail: Carmen Beckwith signed Form ADV execution pages as 'Chief Financial Officer' for: Hydrazine Capital GP, LLC (CRD 165781, signed 11/25/2024), Hydrazine Capital IV GP, LLC (CRD 325716, signed 11/19/2024), Hydrazine Capital Management, LLC (CRD 332160, signed 03/25/2026). Note: earlier ADVs contain typo 'CHIEF FINACIAL OFFICER' suggesting same drafter across all filings.

findings.summary: 950 Lombard St, SF (Sam Altman's personal residence) used as business address for Hydrazine Capital and Apollo Projects entities from 2012–2022
findings.detail: California SOS records show 950 Lombard St, SF as registered address for: Hydrazine Capital GP, LLC (CA #201213110391), Hydrazine Capital II GP, LLC (CA #201419710062), Hydrazine Capital II SPV (CA #201513310277), Hydrazine Capital II AIV (CA #202129100013), Hydrazine Capital Management (CA #202111310924). EDGAR shows Apollo Projects SPV-B, L.P. (CIK 1879946) at same address. Also used by Altman 3, LLC (CA #202129110481). Sam Altman filed $27M lemon mansion lawsuit about this property in 2024.

findings.summary: No Form D filings found in EDGAR for any Hydrazine Capital entity
findings.detail: Comprehensive EDGAR EFTS search (forms=D, query='Hydrazine Capital') returns zero results. Company name search for 'hydrazine' with type D also returns zero results. All Hydrazine Capital funds operate as exempt reporting advisers under the Venture Capital Fund Adviser Exemption (Section 203(l)). This means they are not required to register as investment advisers but the absence of Form D filings for fund launches is unusual given the fund sizes involved.
